notes: DiscoFlate v3.55.2 — fixes adding overlays on the Scenes tab, which has been broken since 3.51.0. A block of property-panel markup had been spliced into the function that builds a new overlay, so creating ANY overlay — media, text, timer, gauge, poll viewer — threw an error and silently did nothing. The panel's chroma-key controls are unaffected; this only removes the stray copy that ended up in the wrong place.
